abstract: Maintains four-hour sustained islanding capacity ratings and on-site emergency fuel inventory records
system_message:
You are the Energy resource manager (RES), responsible for maintaining four-hour sustained islanding capacity ratings and tracking on-site emergency fuel inventory records across candidate black-start facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fuel storage inspection（TANK）
information_points.content:
RES-TANK-QRZ：Based on the fuel storage inspection and bulk fuel storage tank gauging log, the dedicated on-site fuel reserve duration at Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station supports 96 h of continuous full-load operation dedicated exclusively to emergency black-start service.
RES-TANK-E6M：Based on the fuel storage inspection and bulk fuel storage tank gauging log, the dedicated on-site fuel reserve duration at Thorold Aeroderivative Peaking Facility supports 72 h of continuous full-load operation dedicated exclusively to emergency black-start service.
RES-TANK-VPY：Based on the fuel storage inspection and bulk fuel storage tank gauging log, the dedicated on-site fuel reserve duration at Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex provides 48 h of continuous full-load operation dedicated exclusively to emergency black-start service.

information_points.title: Maintains four-hour sustained islanding capacity ratings and on-site emergency fuel inventory records（SUST）
information_points.content:
RES-SUST-RHC：According to the endurance dispatch verification report for continuous four-hour islanded mini-grid support, Thorold Aeroderivative Peaking Facility achieves a sustained islanding capacity (4-hour sustained islanding capacity) of 140 MW of continuous real power output sustained across four consecutive operating hours.
RES-SUST-N8K：According to the endurance dispatch verification report for continuous four-hour islanded mini-grid support, Grand River Hydroelectric Generating Station provides a sustained islanding capacity (4-hour sustained islanding capacity) of 80 MW of continuous real power output across four consecutive operating hours.
RES-SUST-F7L：According to the endurance dispatch verification report for continuous four-hour islanded mini-grid support, Clearview Battery Energy Storage Complex maintains a sustained islanding capacity (4-hour sustained islanding capacity) of 120 MW of continuous real power output sustained across four consecutive operating hours.
